 Canal+ Polska adds six Korean dramas to its streaming offer
 The new selection, curated with Canal+ Distribution, includes titles from CJ ENM, SBS and Studio Genie, expanding the group’s Korean content offering in Poland.
 por Señal News 
 news@senalnews.com
 @senalnews
 @senalnews
 @senalnews
 Share 
 Canal+ Polska has partnered with Canal+ Distribution to expand its Korean drama offering in Poland, bringing six titles to its streaming platform. The selection includes productions from South Korean studios CJ ENM , SBS and Studio Genie , covering drama, romance, suspense and thriller. 
 “Lovely Runner”, “True Beauty”, “Doctor Romantic”, “The Scarecrow”, “Taxi Driver” and “The Penthouse” are now available on canalplus.pl. In addition, “True Beauty” and “Lovely Runner” will premiere on the Canal+ Seriale linear channel in late October. 
 The package was curated with support from Canal+ Distribution , which manages a portfolio spanning more than 180 channels and over 5.000 hours of drama series. The deal strengthens the group’s strategy of combining international content with its local platforms and broadcast services.
 The launch marks another step in the expansion of Korean drama across Canal+’s markets, as the genre continues to build an international audience. For Canal+ Polska , the agreement adds a broader range of Korean scripted content across streaming and linear distribution.
